questions.question: Why did the party take Wolf’s head to Stormspire Academy instead of just carrying the whole body?
questions.expected_answer: The group wanted someone at Stormspire Academy to help cast Speak with Dead so they could learn more about Wolf’s plans. Bonogo did not want to carry an entire body, so he removed Wolf’s head and brought that instead.

questions.question: What did Thalia do when the guards stopped the group outside the Council Chambers?
questions.expected_answer: Thalia explained the situation to the guards and set them on alert for anyone with oily eyes.

questions.question: What weird checkpoint did the covert ops group create in the street, and how did the party respond?
questions.expected_answer: A covert ops group shone a light on the party and demanded to know if they were carrying any meat. Bonogo and Baergrom dumped hundreds of pounds of meat into the street, and the guards acted quickly while a mage burned the tainted meat.

questions.question: When the group arrived at Stormspire Academy, what was the Academy already doing to respond to the crisis?
questions.expected_answer: Stormspire Academy was bustling with activity. Wizards were making potions, crafting runes, and working on wards.

questions.question: What two useful things did Mossglade tell the party before they split up?
questions.expected_answer: Mossglade told them about the study room where they could rest and recharge, and she told them Torbin was in the infirmary under Professor Tealeaf’s care.

questions.question: When the party first split at the Academy, who went to check on Torbin and who went toward the Necromancer?
questions.expected_answer: Ephanna and Baergrom went to check on Torbin. Karsemine, Bonogo, Stafl, and Caelynn went to meet with the Necromancer.

questions.question: What did Ephanna and Baergrom learn about Tealeaf’s situation with Torbin?
questions.expected_answer: They learned that Professor Tealeaf had been unable to help Torbin and had also not been able to help work on potions.

questions.question: What happened during the magical short rest in the study room?
questions.expected_answer: The group used the study room for a magical short rest, and Caelynn played a wonderful song on her mother’s pan flute.

questions.question: After the rest, what problem forced the party to split again, and who took each job?
questions.expected_answer: A piece of meat from Caelynn’s bag had escaped and was loose in the Academy. Stafl and Bonogo went to the Necromancer for the ritual, Caelynn, Baergrom, and Karsemine hunted the meat, and Ephanna stayed with Torbin.

questions.question: Why did Stafl and Bonogo only get four questions for Wolf during the Speak with Dead ritual?
questions.expected_answer: The Speak with Dead ritual granted five questions, but Stafl had promised one question to the Necromancer, leaving Stafl and Bonogo with four.

questions.question: When Wolf was asked what killed him, who did he indicate, and why is that easy to confuse with the later fight?
questions.expected_answer: Wolf indicated Bonogo by nodding toward him. This is distinct from the later basement fight where Bonogo kills Draven and later attacks a sleeping guard.

questions.question: What did Wolf say about Lira versus the Shepherd, and what should I not conflate between them?
questions.expected_answer: Wolf said the plotters operate in small groups, so the total number is not known, but Lira will finish the plot before she dies. Separately, Wolf said the Shepherd is everywhere, in the minds of the people, and that the Shepherd will rise from below at the break of dawn.

questions.question: Right before the ambush, what did Cinderbranch do and what did Draven do?
questions.expected_answer: After the ritual, Professor Cinderbranch left the room. Just as that happened, Draven closed and locked the door.

questions.question: Which guards were helpful earlier, and which guards attacked Stafl and Bonogo later?
questions.expected_answer: Earlier, city guards stopped the group but Thalia explained the situation and set them on alert; guards also acted when the tainted meat was dumped in the street. Later, two Elite Guards entered the basement morgue with the Sewer Meat Monster and attacked Stafl and Bonogo.

questions.question: Where did Wolf say the meat-storage strongholds were?
questions.expected_answer: Wolf said the meat-storage strongholds were hidden in the walls, the guardhouses, and underground.

questions.question: What exactly is the unresolved dawn threat the party learned from Wolf?
questions.expected_answer: Wolf said there is no stopping the plan, that they are gathering now and will soon erupt as something new led by the Shepherd. The sign of completion will be at the break of dawn, when the Shepherd rises from below. The recap does not resolve what the Shepherd physically is or exactly where below means.

questions.question: Why is the empty ritual room a bad sign after Stafl and Bonogo explain what happened?
questions.expected_answer: After Stafl and Bonogo explained the ambush to Cinderbranch, the ritual room was found empty. The recap frames that as a bad sign of what is to come, but it does not specify exactly who or what removed the contents or what immediate consequence follows.

questions.question: What unresolved Academy problem exists outside the morgue fight?
questions.expected_answer: A piece of meat from Caelynn’s bag escaped and was loose in the Academy. Caelynn, Baergrom, and Karsemine went to hunt it, but the recap does not describe the resolution of that hunt.

questions.question: If I need to reconstruct the morgue ambush mechanically, what enemies and battlefield effects are explicitly established?
questions.expected_answer: The ambush includes Draven, two Elite Guards, and a large disgusting Sewer Meat Monster. The monster moves to the center of the room and oozes goo in a 10-foot radius. Draven casts Fear on Bonogo, the Elite Guards can poison with their attacks, and the Sewer Meat Monster bites Bonogo.

questions.question: How did Sleep change the morgue fight, and who used it?
questions.expected_answer: Stafl cast Sleep on Draven, causing Draven to fall asleep, which let Bonogo sneak attack him for massive damage and kill him. Later, after running outside the door and yelling for help, Stafl cast Sleep on the remaining enemies.

questions.question: Who shows up or is meaningfully present at Stormspire Academy during this session?
questions.expected_answer: At Stormspire Academy, the recap meaningfully places Head Clerk Mossglade, Professor Cinderbranch, Professor Tealeaf, Torbin in the infirmary, the Necromancer, Draven, Stafl, Bonogo, Caelynn, Baergrom, Karsemine, Ephanna, wizards or mages working on potions, runes, and wards, two Elite Guards, and the Sewer Meat Monster. Wolf’s head is also brought there for the ritual, but Wolf is dead rather than living there.

questions.question: Does the recap establish that Mossglade lives at Stormspire Academy, or only that she works there?
questions.expected_answer: The recap only establishes that Mossglade is the Head Clerk at Stormspire Academy and is at the desk when the party arrives. It does not say she lives there.

questions.question: What did the Necromancer ask Wolf, and is the Necromancer identified as Draven before the ambush?
questions.expected_answer: The Necromancer asked: what is the plan and how will we know when it is complete? The recap does not explicitly state that the Necromancer and Draven are the same person before the ambush, though Draven closes and locks the door immediately after Cinderbranch leaves.

questions.question: What happened to Bonogo after he missed Elite Guard 2?
questions.expected_answer: After Bonogo missed Elite Guard 2 with his bonus attack, that guard attacked and hit Bonogo, poisoning him. Just as he was being poisoned, the Sewer Meat Monster bit him and dealt more damage.

questions.question: By the end of the recap, what has actually been resolved about Torbin?
questions.expected_answer: Nothing in the recap resolves Torbin’s condition. Ephanna stays with him, and earlier Ephanna and Baergrom learned that Tealeaf had been unable to help him, but the recap does not state that Torbin recovers.
